limits: Synthetic single-host/single-computational-thread evidence; no real-data, parallel scaling or durable replay claim.

Three independently converged Python references pass scientific and performance comparisons. Three failures remain failures; fixed-native-parameter checks do not supply independent optimizer parity or speedup evidence.
Cold means fresh complete CLI processes and warm filesystem; warm uses actual Python worker and native CSV/control services, including all ablations and serialization.
Native profiling is separate from final timing. No task compiler/profiler/workspace suite overlapped final paired timings.
RSS is a separate one-shot macOS time -l maximum per successful case/implementation, not a simultaneous process-tree sum.
The initial late-fusion harness had an undefined pathlib name; retained separately as a harness failure. Corrected independent comparisons fail the harness if parity or speedup is not established.
The conformal recheck expands the earlier typed-spec warm boundary to actual CSV/control application input; do not compare absolute warm timings across those boundaries as a native regression.
